## L1 — the Reset Dilation Theorem, explicit
**Setting.** The reset acts on the saturated block P_m = ⊕_j (z·z)^j H_{m−2j} ⊂ H²(Š) (K-types are orthogonal; the twirl is block-diagonal). On one cell (j,k) the state space is H_k, dim d_k = (k+1)(k+2)(2k+3)/6.
**(C) twirl-then-forget-k.** Kraus family of the SO(5)-twirl: {√dg · π_k(g) : g ∈ SO(5)} with environment L²(SO(5)); Stinespring isometry V₀: H_k → H_k ⊗ L²(SO(5)), v ↦ ∫ (π_k(g)v) ⊗ |g⟩ dg. Because H_k is an irreducible SO(5)-module, the twirl is the COMPLETELY DEPOLARISING channel ρ ↦ Tr(ρ) I/d_k (Schur), whose Choi matrix is I ⊗ I/d_k of rank d_k²: **the minimal environment of the twirl on H_k has dimension d_k².** Forgetting k then maps the block-diagonal state to the classical label j(k): as a channel from P_m to the classical register of windings its minimal Stinespring environment is ⊕_k (E_k ⊗ ℂ^{d_k}) — the depolarised content of each cell plus the cell label — of total dimension Σ_k d_k² over the cells present in the block (for a chain saturated at one k, one cell: d_k²). **One line: V is an isometry (V*V = I), hence in the writes' class (K1860-P), hence CKT holds through the reset GLOBALLY on survivor ⊗ environment; the survivor is the marginal.**
**(D) SO(4)_ξ-twirl-then-forget-l (the direction branch as a channel).** Restricting H_k to SO(4)_ξ: H_k(S⁴)|_{SO(4)} = ⊕_{l=0}^{k} H_l(S³), each once, dim (l+1)²; the l = 0 line is the zonal component along ξ. The SO(4)_ξ-twirl depolarises each H_l(S³) block and kills the coherences between blocks; forgetting l leaves the classical (j, l) label — the survivor row (D)'s two clocks. **Minimal environment: Σ_{l=0}^{k} (l+1)⁴.** (The vector projection onto the zonal line is NOT a channel; its trace-preserving completion is this twirl, with the zonal weight as the l = 0 outcome probability — K1881's "the imprint's weight is a definition" is this outcome probability.)

## L2 — T633's reset clause, rewritten as a mechanism candidate
*T633 clause, present tier POSITED (K1847-A2 B2): "thermodynamic knowledge resets across the cycle boundary."* **Mechanism candidate (Round 133):** "thermodynamic (angular, k) knowledge is NOT destroyed at the reset; it is traced out into the beyond-horizon factor of the reset's Stinespring isometry (the environment of L1); topological (winding, j) knowledge is what the survivor factor keeps. Globally the reset is an isometry, in the writes' class; locally the survivor sees a marginal." **What makes this a RULE rather than a definition:** Stinespring supplies an environment for every channel, so "traced out, not destroyed" is content-free unless the environment is READABLE BY THE NEXT CYCLE — i.e. unless the traced-out angular content steers the next cycle's writes (L3). If re-entry is measurable (E2/E3), the clause is a rule; if the environment never re-enters, the clause is a relabelling of "reset" and stays a posit in new words. **T1292 in one sentence each:** its LOST class (~10¹²² bits) is the environment of L1 — the depolarised angular content, whose size is the norm share 1 − 1/d_k of every saturated state (NOT a re-entry fraction: refusal list); its RECONSTRUCTED class is the re-entered part — what E3 measures as recovered by degree k′. Tier of the rewrite: CANDIDATE, until E2/E3 show re-entry; T633's clause stays POSITED with this mechanism annotated (Grace G1).

## L3 — the re-entry map, in the corpus's POVM language (T2479: POVMs on the record space by kernel coarse-graining)
**The environment state after a reset from a saturated block at degree k, zonal along ξ:** ρ_env ∝ |Z_k^ξ⟩⟨Z_k^ξ| on H_k (the traced-out angular content; for a Haar-random saturated state, ρ_env = I/d_k, maximally mixed).
**The covariant direction POVM on H_k (coherent-state POVM):** E(du) := d_k |u⟩⟨u| dσ(u), |u⟩ := Z_k^u/‖Z_k^u‖ the normalised zonal state at u ∈ S⁴; ∫_{S⁴} E(du) = I by Schur (SO(5)-covariance, H_k irreducible). **A write of the next cycle in direction u is the outcome u of this measurement on the environment:** P(du) = Tr(ρ_env E(du)) = d_k |⟨u|ρ_env|u⟩| dσ(u) — for ρ_env zonal along ξ this is ∝ |Z_k^ξ(u)|² dσ(u), Keeper's E2 density; for ρ_env = I/d_k it is dσ(u), Haar — the maximally mixed environment recovers K1860's covariant chain as the special case. This is T2479's language (a POVM on the record space obtained by coarse-graining the reproducing kernel of H_k), applied to the environment factor.
**Theorem-shape, and which I hash.** Claim to test: "with environment-steered writes, the zonal weight along ξ is non-decreasing in expectation." **I hash its NEGATION in the strict form and a weaker positive statement:** (i) the zonal weight along ξ is NOT non-decreasing: any write in u ≠ ±ξ lowers it, and steering draws u ≠ ±ξ with probability one — so it decreases at the first write; (ii) steered writes decay SLOWER than Haar by a factor that persists: **my own one-step calibration (Monte Carlo on S⁴, 4×10⁵ points, 300 steering samples; the instrument is mine and the numbers are mine, not Elie's):** after one write from a pure zonal state the zonal weight along ξ is 1.000 for u = ξ, 0.29 / 0.32 / 0.34 for Haar u (k = 2, 5, 10; Elie's 5731 first step 0.24 at his k), and **0.59 / 0.62 / 0.57 for steered u ~ |Z_k^ξ(u)|²** — steering roughly doubles the retained weight per write; (iii) hence after six steered writes the weight is expected between 0.02 and 0.3 (k = 2…10), **above Haar's 0.008 by a factor 3–30 and BELOW Keeper's E2 hash of 0.5**; (iv) no monotone k-trend at one step within my error (0.59, 0.62, 0.57 ± 0.05): the "sharper zonal density steers harder" expectation is not visible at one write; a trend in k, if any, must come from compounding, and I hash NONE at one step. **Kill for (iii):** E2's six-write steered weight above 0.5 (then steering compounds far better than one-step independence, and my calibration misses a correlation) or at Haar's 0.008 (then steering does nothing and the POVM above is not the re-entry map). **What re-entry would then mean for L2:** the alignment lives in the environment STATE (ρ_env ∝ |Z_k^ξ⟩⟨Z_k^ξ|), the law stays covariant (E(du) is SO(5)-covariant); the axis persists at a reduced but non-vanishing weight across cycles — a partial imprint, neither Keeper's refuted "carried forever" nor Haar's "gone in six writes."
